owner: Central Electronics Limited (CEL, DST PSU) + ESDS Software Solution
notes: Foundation stone for the Rs 1,000 crore, 30 MW Tier III green data centre at Sahibabad, Ghaziabad was laid on 26-27 Jun 2025 by UP CM Yogi Adityanath and Union Minister Dr Jitendra Singh (CEL golden jubilee). CEL is a PSU under the Ministry of Science & Technology; with ESDS; includes 40 Gbps fibre, dual 10 Gbps cloud links, high-density racks. Status: foundation laid, under construction.
